description:
Goal: remove the alternate native closure-target model that became unreachable after the producer-owned callable construction work landed. Current production evidence: build_codegen_closure_targets returns an empty map; native lowering always writes direct_target=None for CallClosure/TailCallClosure; concrete direct executable calls use DirectCallTarget::Local; public callable values enter through NativeCallableBoundaryId wrappers.

Delete NativeClosureTargetSurface, NativeCodegenSurface.closure_targets, build_codegen_closure_targets, its test-only registry/rebinding model, dead direct-target entry/signature/terminator branches, and stale tests/comments/docs that describe consumer-reconstructed capture+argument surfaces. If the fz-IR direct_target field has no remaining production producer, remove it rather than preserving a permanently-None affordance. Keep static callable-boundary singletons and producer-owned callable member/direct-call facts: those are the live model, not this registry.

Tests must retain behavioral intent rather than obsolete mechanics. Acceptance: closure_typed_captures, curried_add, multi_caller_spec_divergent, the two-distinct-Enum.map case, and representative zero-capture/resource destructor closures pass on run/interp/build; cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass; docs describe producer construction -> public callable boundary -> indirect call without a per-FnId native surface reconstruction step.

comments.text: IMPLEMENTATION ATTEMPT 2026-07-09: stopped without commit. Search confirms ticket is not satisfied: native_codegen/driver.rs still has build_codegen_closure_targets, and drive_test still has an expected-failure regression referencing build_codegen_closure_targets/capture-count gap. Obvious deletion path exposed a model issue: native codegen currently assumes one FnId -> NativeClosureTargetSurface, but shared Enum.find/find_value-style fixtures can produce multiple callable-boundary surfaces for the same target FnId. Correct cleanup needs a boundary-aware closure-target surface model: key explicit surfaces by boundary/direct surface, resolve direct closure calls via the closure var's boundary id when present, keep direct-only fallback for no-boundary closure calls, then delete build_codegen_closure_targets and retire the stale expected-failure test. Closure regression fixtures plus cargo test --lib and clippy were green in the attempted worktree.

title: Delete the unreachable native closure-target registry and direct-call branches
